_comentario: 'Read and Draw', el cuaderno en inglés. Datos de origen para tools/gen_days.py --libro english. Este fichero SI se edita a mano; content/english/generated-days.tex NO (se regenera con `make generate`). Parte 2 (invierno): días 66-130, semanas 14-26, en presente (con presente continuo, like + -ing y comparativos). Hilo: dos Navidades, la nieve, Carnaval y Pancake Day, y la primavera que llega -- ver notes/05-english.md.

texto: In the living room, the nativity scene is on the top shelf.
On the right, there is a stable with a star on top. On the left, three Kings stand next to a palm tree.
Every night they move closer, but nobody knows who moves them!

actividad.prompt: Draw the nativity scene on the shelf.
comprueba: What is on the right? What is on top of it?
Where are the Kings?
What is next to the Kings?
actividad.clave: On the right, a stable with a star on top; on the left, three Kings standing next to a palm tree.

texto: Next door, the Browns are decorating their house for Christmas.
Amy is hanging a big red stocking on her bedroom door.
On Christmas Eve, Father Christmas puts presents in it, if you are good! Sam is sure that he is very good.

preguntas.pregunta: What are the Browns doing?
Where is Amy's stocking?
Who puts presents in the stocking?

texto: Lucía and Amy talk about Christmas in their two countries.
In England, children open their presents on Christmas Day.
In Spain, many children wait for the Three Kings, who come in January. Amy thinks that Spanish children are very patient!

actividad.instruccion: What goes with each one? Read and match.

texto: On Thursday, Pip learns something new.
Every time somebody comes in, he shouts “Merry Christmas!” The postman laughs so much that he drops his letters!
Amy says that Pip is the best Christmas decoration in the house.

frases: In the living room, the nativity scene is on the top ___.
Amy is hanging a big red ___ on her bedroom door.
The postman laughs so much that he drops his ___!
Amy says that Pip is the best Christmas ___ in the house.

texto: On Friday, the two families make paper snowflakes together.
Lucía's snowflake has got six points, like a real one. Dani cuts his into tiny pieces, which fall like snow!
They hang all the snowflakes in the windows.

checklist: I know where the Kings are in the nativity scene.
I know what Amy hangs on her door.
I know what Pip shouts now.
actividad.prompt: Now draw a snowflake with six points.

texto: On Christmas Eve, Lucía's family has dinner at Grandma Rosa's flat.
On the table, there are two red candles and a big fish. For dessert, there are sweets made of almonds and honey.
Dani eats so many that he falls asleep on the sofa!

actividad.prompt: Draw the table at Grandma Rosa's flat on Christmas Eve.
comprueba: How many candles are there, and what colour are they?
What is there for dinner?
What is there for dessert?
actividad.clave: Two red candles and a big fish on the table; sweets made of almonds and honey for dessert.

texto: On Christmas morning, Amy and Sam wake up very early. Their stockings are full of presents!
Amy gets a box of paints, which she loves. Sam gets a dinosaur that roars.
Pip gets a new swing for his cage.

afirmaciones: Amy and Sam wake up very late.
Their stockings are full of presents.
Amy gets a box of paints.
Pip gets a new bell.

texto: At lunchtime, Lucía's family goes next door for Christmas lunch.
In the Browns' living room, the tree is next to the sofa. Pip's cage is on the little table, so Pip can see everyone.
Toby lies under the table, where it is warm.

actividad.prompt: Where are they? Read the text and draw them in the Browns' living room.
actividad.clave: The Christmas tree next to the sofa; Pip's cage on the little table; Toby under the table.

texto: Before lunch, everyone pulls a Christmas cracker. When you pull it, it goes “Bang!”
Inside, there is a paper crown, a joke and a little toy.
Toby runs away, because he doesn't like the bang!

that he falls asleep on the sofa!

Everyone is wearing a paper crown from the crackers.
Lucía says that it is the best Christmas ever!

actividad.instruccion: Draw the story of this week: the beginning, the middle and the end.
pies: Lucía's family has dinner at Grandma's flat.
Amy and Sam open their stockings.

texto: In Spain, people eat twelve grapes on New Year's Eve.
Mum puts four bowls of grapes on a round tray. Dad's bowl is red, and Mum's is blue. Lucía's is green, and Dani's is yellow.
Each bowl has got twelve purple grapes, because there are twelve months.

actividad.prompt: Draw the tray with the four bowls of grapes.
comprueba: What shape is the tray?
What colour is each bowl?
How many grapes are in each bowl, and what colour are they?
actividad.clave: A round tray with four bowls: Dad's red, Mum's blue, Lucía's green and Dani's yellow; twelve purple grapes in each.

texto: You eat one grape every time the clock goes “Dong!” There are twelve “Dongs”, so you have to eat very fast!
Next door, Amy is practising with raisins, because they are smaller.
Toby can't have any grapes, because they are bad for dogs.

afirmaciones: You eat one grape every time the clock goes “Dong!”
There are ten “Dongs”.
Amy is practising with raisins.
Grapes are good for dogs.

texto: At midnight, everyone is watching the big clock on television.
Dong! Dong! Dong! Lucía eats all her grapes. Next door, Amy eats only five, because she is laughing too much.
Then there are fireworks, and Toby hides under the bed.

sucesos: Mum puts four bowls of grapes on a tray.

texto: On New Year's Day, Lucía and Amy write their wishes.
Lucía wants to read a whole book in English. Amy wants to learn to ride a horse, because she loves animals.
Dani wants Toby to talk, like Pip!

actividad.instruccion: What does Lucía want to read? What does Amy want to ride? Find the two words in the text and write them.

texto: The next day, the sun is shining, but it is very cold.
The children go to the park in their new hats and gloves.
Sam is wearing a dinosaur hat that he got for Christmas. It has got green spikes on top!

checklist: I know how many grapes you eat on New Year's Eve.

actividad.prompt: Now draw your wish for the new year.

texto: Lucía helps Dani to write his letter to the Three Kings.
Dani wants a torch, so that he can read in bed. He also asks for a red ball for Toby, whose ball is old.
At the bottom, he draws three crowns and a big star.

actividad.prompt: Draw Dani's letter to the Three Kings, with his drawings.
comprueba: What does Dani want for himself?
What does he want for Toby, and what colour is it?
What does he draw at the bottom?
actividad.clave: A torch for Dani and a red ball for Toby; at the bottom, three crowns and a big star.

texto: On the fifth of January, there is a big parade in the city.
The Kings are riding camels and throwing sweets, which fall like rain! Sam is on Mr Brown's shoulders, so he can see everything.
Amy catches ten sweets in her hat!

preguntas.pregunta: When is the parade?
What are the Kings throwing?
Where does Amy catch the sweets?

texto: Mr Brown buys a King cake, which is round like a ring.
It is golden brown, and on top there are orange and green fruits. There is a red cherry, and a gold paper crown in the middle.
Amy has never seen a cake like this!

actividad.prompt: Colour the King cake. Read the text to find the colours.
actividad.clave: A golden brown cake with orange and green fruits, a red cherry and a gold paper crown in the middle.

texto: Inside the King cake, there is a little king and a bean.
The person who finds the little king wears the crown. Amy finds the king, and Sam finds the bean!
Now Sam must buy the cake next year, but he is only five!

frases: Inside the King cake, there is a little king and a ___.
The person who finds the little king wears the ___.

texto: In the afternoon, Dani plays with his new torch all the time.
He shines it under the sofa, where Toby hides his new ball.
Sam wants a torch too, so they play together until dinner. The two little boys are very happy.

actividad.instruccion: Draw the story of this week: the beginning, the middle and the end.
pies: Dani writes a letter to the Three Kings.
The Kings throw sweets at the parade.
Amy finds the little king in the King cake.

texto: The school playground is white with snow!
In the middle is a snowman that is as tall as a grown-up. It has got two black stones for eyes and a carrot nose.

texto: Amy is very excited, because it doesn't often snow here. In London, it snows a little every winter.
At break time, the children throw snowballs and slide on the ice.
Lucía's hands are so cold that she puts them in her pockets.

preguntas.pregunta: Why is Amy excited?
opciones: because it doesn't often snow here
preguntas.solucion: because it doesn't often snow here

preguntas.pregunta: What do the children throw at break time?

texto: After school, Lucía and Amy make a snowman in the garden.
It has got Dad's old black hat and Mum's red scarf. Its nose is an orange carrot, and it has got three blue buttons.
Pip watches from the window, because it is too cold outside.

actividad.prompt: Colour Lucía and Amy's snowman. Read the text to find the colours.
actividad.clave: A black hat, a red scarf, an orange carrot nose and three blue buttons.

texto: Toby loves the snow! He jumps in it and tries to catch the snowflakes with his mouth.
When he comes inside, he is white and wet.
Pip looks at him and says “Brrr!”, which makes everyone laugh.

texto: By Friday, the snow is melting.
The snowman in the garden is getting smaller and smaller. Soon, only the hat, the scarf and the carrot are left.
Lucía is sad, but Amy says that it can snow again.

checklist: I know what is on the left of the snowman at school.
I know why Amy is excited.
I know what Pip says to Toby.
actividad.prompt: Now draw a snowman of your own.

texto: Dani has got a cold, so he stays at home today.
He is in bed with a hot water bottle and his toy dinosaur. Next to his bed, there is a glass of orange juice.
Toby is sleeping on the rug, because he doesn't want to leave Dani.

actividad.prompt: Draw Dani in bed.
comprueba: What has Dani got in his bed?
What is next to his bed?
Where is Toby?
actividad.clave: Dani in bed with a hot water bottle and his toy dinosaur; a glass of orange juice next to the bed; Toby sleeping on the rug.

texto: Mum takes Dani's temperature, and it is a bit high.
She gives him some medicine that tastes of strawberries. Dani has to drink a lot of water and sleep a lot.
“Can I watch cartoons?” he asks, and Mum says yes.

afirmaciones: Dani's temperature is a bit high.
The medicine tastes of bananas.
Dani has to drink a lot of water.
Mum says that Dani can't watch cartoons.

texto: Sam can't come in, because Dani is ill. So he makes Dani a card, and Amy brings it.
Mum puts the card on the desk, where Dani can see it.
The dinosaur is on the bed, and his slippers are under the chair.

actividad.prompt: Where are they? Read the text and draw them in Dani's bedroom.
actividad.clave: The card on the desk; the toy dinosaur on the bed; the slippers under the chair.

texto: The card has got a riddle on it, because Sam loves riddles.
It is about an animal that Dani loves. Dani reads it three times, and then he shouts the answer!
Next door, Sam hears him and claps.

actividad.adivinanza:
I have got a long neck and a long tail.
I eat leaves from the tallest trees.
I am very big, and very, very old.
What am I?
actividad.respuesta: A dinosaur with a long neck, like a diplodocus.

texto: On Friday, Dani is well again, and he goes back to school. His friends give him a big hug.
At home, he makes a card for Sam, which says “Thank you!”
Mum is happy, because Dani is eating a lot again.

actividad.instruccion: Draw the story of this week: the beginning, the middle and the end.
pies: Dani has got a cold and stays in bed.
Sam makes a card with a riddle for Dani.
Dani is well again and goes back to school.

texto: On the thirtieth of January, it is Peace Day at school.
Marta's class paints a big white dove, which means peace. In its beak, there is a green leaf, and its wings are open.
Around it, the children paint their hands in the colours that they like.

actividad.prompt: Draw the Peace Day dove on the wall.
comprueba: What colour is the dove?
What is in its beak?
What is around the dove?
actividad.clave: A big white dove with its wings open and a green leaf in its beak; the children's hands in many colours around it.

texto: At break time, Lucía and Amy want to play different games.
Lucía wants to play tag, but Amy wants to play with the skipping rope. They both get angry, because nobody wants to change.
When the bell rings, they walk back to class alone.

preguntas.pregunta: What does Lucía want to play?
What does Amy want to play with?
Why do they get angry?

texto: That evening, Lucía can't eat her dinner, because she feels bad.
Mum says that friends don't always want the same things. “You can take turns,” she says.
Lucía thinks about it while she is brushing her teeth.

don't always want the same things.

texto: The next morning, Lucía knocks on Amy's door before school.
“I'm sorry,” she says. “Me too!” says Amy, and she gives her a hug.
They decide that today they play tag, and tomorrow they skip. Pip, who is listening, shouts “Hooray!”

sucesos: Lucía and Amy want to play different games.

texto: At school, Lucía and Amy write a peace poem together:

> A friend is someone who listens,
A friend is someone who shares,

checklist: I know what the dove has got in its beak.
I know why Lucía and Amy get angry.

actividad.prompt: Now draw you and your best friend playing together.
actividad.banner: 100 pages read! You're a reading star!

texto: On Saturday, Mr Brown takes the boys to the museum.
In the biggest room is a dinosaur that is longer than a bus! It has got a very long neck, a long tail and four big legs.
Next to it is a small dinosaur, which is as big as a dog.

actividad.prompt: Draw the two dinosaurs in the museum.
comprueba: How long is the big dinosaur?
What has it got?
How big is the small dinosaur?
actividad.clave: A big dinosaur, longer than a bus, with a very long neck, a long tail and four big legs; next to it, a small dinosaur as big as a dog.

texto: A guide tells the boys about the big dinosaur, which is called a diplodocus.
It only ate plants, so it wasn't dangerous. It lived millions of years ago, when there were no people.
Dani asks if it was heavier than an elephant. “Much heavier!” says the guide.

afirmaciones: The big dinosaur is called a diplodocus.
It ate meat.
It lived when there were no people.
It was lighter than an elephant.

texto: In the next room, there is a Tyrannosaurus rex. It has got big teeth and very short arms.
It ate meat, not plants. It is the dinosaur that Sam likes best.
Dani holds Mr Brown's hand, because its teeth are so big.

actividad.instruccion: Read the texts of this week again and match.
pares: is as big as a dog

texto: In the museum shop, the boys can choose one thing each.
Dani chooses a book about dinosaurs, because he wants to learn all their names. Sam chooses a cap, which has got a diplodocus on it.
Mr Brown buys a postcard for Amy.

actividad.instruccion: What do Dani and Sam choose in the shop? Find the two things in the text and write them.

texto: At home, Dani and Sam tell Amy and Lucía about the museum. Dani says that the diplodocus was longer than their street!
Then they make a dinosaur museum in the living room.
Toby is the guard, because he doesn't let anybody touch the dinosaurs!

actividad.instruccion: Draw the story of this week: the beginning, the middle and the end.
pies: Mr Brown takes Dani and Sam to the museum.
A guide tells them about the diplodocus.
The boys make a dinosaur museum at home.

texto: This week it is Carnival, and Lucía is going to be a detective.
She has got a brown checked cap and a long beige coat. Her magnifying glass, which hangs from a red string, is Grandma's.
Amy is going to be a green parrot, because she loves Pip.

actividad.prompt: Draw Lucía in her detective costume.

actividad.clave: A brown checked cap, a long beige coat and Grandma's magnifying glass hanging from a red string.

texto: On Tuesday, all the classes meet in the gym for a photo.
Then they walk around the playground while the music is playing. Dani is the head of a dragon, and Sam is its tail!
When the parade ends, Lucía finds a purple mask on the floor.

preguntas.pregunta: Where do the classes meet for a photo?
What is Sam in the dragon?
What does Lucía find on the floor?

texto: It is very windy, so Dad takes the children to the hill.
He has got a big kite, which is shaped like a diamond. It is red and yellow, and its long tail has got four blue bows.
When the wind blows, the kite flies higher than the trees!

comprueba: What shape is the kite?
What colours is it?
How many bows has its tail got, and what colour are they?
actividad.clave: A red and yellow kite shaped like a diamond, with a long tail and four blue bows, flying higher than the trees.

texto: Amy and Sam have got a kite too, but theirs is smaller.
Their kite, which is shaped like a fish, is orange. Sam holds the string while Amy runs as fast as she can.
At last, the fish flies too, and Sam shouts with joy.

afirmaciones: Amy and Sam's kite is bigger than Dad's.
Their kite is shaped like a fish.
Sam holds the string.

texto: When they get home, Lucía draws Dad's kite.
The two top parts are red, and the two bottom parts are yellow. The tail is black, and the four bows on it are blue.
Dad puts the drawing on the fridge, where everybody can see it.

actividad.prompt: Colour Lucía's drawing of the kite. Read the text to find the colours.
actividad.clave: The two top parts red, the two bottom parts yellow, a black tail and four blue bows.

texto: That night, the wind is still blowing.
Pip's cage is inside, because the wind is too strong for a little bird. Lucía listens to the wind while she is falling asleep.
She dreams that she is flying like a kite, high above the city.

actividad.instruccion: Draw the story of this week: the beginning, the middle and the end.
pies: Dad and the children fly a kite on the hill.
The wind takes Dad's hat, and Toby brings it back.
Lucía dreams that she is flying like a kite.

texto: After school, the girls go to the library, which is next to the park.
In the corner, there is a small shelf that has got books in English. There is a green sofa under the window, and a rug with stars.
Tomás, the librarian, gives them two library cards.

actividad.prompt: Draw the English corner in the library.
comprueba: What is in the corner?
What colour is the sofa, and where is it?
What is on the rug?
actividad.clave: A small shelf with books in English in the corner; a green sofa under the window; a rug with stars.

Amy chooses a book of poems, because she likes reading aloud. They can take the books home for two weeks.
Tomás says that they must bring them back on time.

preguntas.pregunta: What is Lucía's book about?

preguntas.solucion: a girl who lives on a boat

preguntas.pregunta: What does Amy choose?

actividad.clave: Lucía sitting on the sofa; Amy lying on the rug; their books on the little table next to the sofa.

texto: Marta's class, which loves science, is going to grow beans.
Each child puts wet cotton wool in a cup, and then two beans. Lucía writes her name on her cup in red letters.
The cups go on the window sill, where there is a lot of sun.

actividad.prompt: Draw Lucía's bean cup on the window sill.
comprueba: What is inside the cup?
How many beans are there?
What is on the cup, and what colour is it?
actividad.clave: A cup with wet cotton wool and two beans; Lucía's name in red letters on the cup; the cup on the sunny window sill.

texto: Every morning, the children look at their beans with a magnifying glass.
On Wednesday, Amy's beans have got little white roots! Lucía's beans haven't got roots yet, because her cotton wool is dry.
She gives them some water, and she hopes that they grow.

afirmaciones: The children look at their beans every morning.

texto: On Thursday, Lucía's beans have got roots too! Marta explains that plants need water, light and warm air.
If a bean hasn't got water, it can't grow. The roots go down, while the little green shoot goes up.
Amy draws her bean every day in her notebook.

mitades: If a bean hasn't got water,
while the little green shoot goes up.
Lucía's beans haven't got roots yet,
because her cotton wool is dry.

texto: How a bean grows:
- First, the bean drinks water and gets bigger.
- Then a little white root comes out.
- After that, a green shoot grows up towards the light.
- Last, the first leaves open.
Amy thinks that it is like magic, but Marta says that it is science!

actividad.instruccion: How does a bean grow? Put it in order. Write 1, 2, 3 and 4.
sucesos: The bean drinks water and gets bigger.
A little white root comes out.
A green shoot grows up towards the light.

texto: On Friday, the children take their beans home.

The beans grow little white roots.
Lucía plants her bean in Dad's garden.

texto: It is spring at last! Under the chestnut tree, there are five yellow flowers.

Sam finds a ladybird on a leaf, and he counts its spots: seven! When Dani tries to catch it, it flies away.

texto: In the afternoon, a butterfly lands on Grandma's knitting.

texto: Pip can see the butterfly from his cage, and he gets very excited.
He says all the words that he knows: “Hello! Toby! Biscuit! Merry Christmas!” Everybody laughs, because it isn't Christmas any more!

actividad.instruccion: Which words does Pip know? Find three of them in the text and write them.

texto: Today is the last day of winter.
Lucía's bean plant has got four leaves, and it is taller than her hand. The girls make a list of things that they want to do in spring.
The first thing is Amy's birthday party, which is next week!

checklist: I know how many grapes Spanish families eat on New Year's Eve.
I know who finds the little king in the King cake.
I know what the snowman at school has got on its left.
I know what beans need to grow.
actividad.prompt: Now draw your favourite moment of the winter.
